ui.import.limitless.intro: Pulls the tournament name, date, format, player count, final standings, records, teams, top cut bracket, and usage stats for the whole field.
ui.import.tdf.intro: Parses standings from a .tdf (XML) file for events run via TOM. All data is processed locally and not retained.

ui.import.teamSheet.intro: Upload the player’s Pokémon Video Game Team List: the PDF, a screenshot of it, or a photo of the paper sheet (printed or handwritten). Regionals / International team sheets (the page with every language) work too. It’s read in your browser and not uploaded anywhere.
ui.import.teamSheet.checkMarked: Check the {count} marked “?” below, then use the team.
ui.import.teamSheet.readAllExact: Read all six from the PDF.
ui.import.teamSheet.readAllCheck: Read all six. Check them over, then use the team.
ui.import.teamSheet.bulkIntro: Add everyone’s team lists at once: photos, scans, screenshots, or PDFs (a PDF can hold a page per player), of the paper form or of Regionals / International team sheets. Each one is matched to a player by the name on the sheet. Everything is read in your browser and not uploaded.
ui.import.teamSheet.sharedTarget: Another team list is also going to this player.
ui.import.teamSheet.useCount: Use {count, plural, one {# team} other {# teams}}
ui.import.standingsPhoto.confirm: Replace the current standings with these {count} players?
ui.import.standingsPhoto.intro: For events that only post a picture: upload a photo or screenshot of a TOM Standings page (column headers visible). A screenshot works best, but even a photo of the standings on a monitor should work. A PDF of the standings page (or TOM’s standings .html report) is read exactly. If several divisions are shown, Masters is used. Everything is read in your browser; check it before using. Teams aren’t on standings pages: for team lists, use “Import team lists for everyone” under Standings below.
ui.import.standingsPhoto.notStandings: This reads standings pages only; a team list goes in “Import team lists for everyone” under Standings below.
ui.import.standingsPhoto.summary: Read {count, plural, one {# player} other {# players}}{from}{plus}. {check}
ui.import.standingsPhoto.checkNames: Check the names; anything the photo blurred may be misspelled.
ui.import.standingsPhoto.compare: Compare against the photo before using these.
ui.import.standingsPhoto.topPlayed: Top {top}: the players who played top cut games.
ui.import.standingsPhoto.topOfficial: Top {top}: the official top cut for {count} players (no top cut games in these standings).
ui.import.standingsPhoto.changeCut: Change it if your event used a different cut.
ui.import.screenshot.intro: Upload a screenshot of the team’s Moves & More screen from Pokémon Champions (phone or Switch). It’s read in your browser and not uploaded anywhere.

ui.preview.photoHint: Drag a photo in the preview to move it in its frame; click another photo to zoom that one. Fit whole photo shows the entire photo over the style’s empty-photo background, for photos the wrong shape for their frame.

ui.replay.heading: Showdown replay
ui.replay.intro: Paste a replay link. For a best-of-3, paste the last game of the set (Game 2 or 3): it has the final record, so the earlier games aren’t needed. An earlier game only gives the score up to that point.
ui.replay.lookingForGames: Looking for the other games in this set…
ui.replay.loaded: Loaded {count, plural, one {# game} other {# games}}.
ui.replay.setDoneFromScoreboard: Best-of-{bestOf} set: {result} in {games} games (set score read from the last game, so earlier games aren’t needed).
ui.replay.setSoFar: Best-of-{bestOf} set so far: {result} after {games, plural, one {# game} other {# games}}. Paste the final game to get the finished result.
ui.replay.noTeamSheets: This replay doesn't include team sheets, so items weren't filled in. Add them below.

ui.replay.addedUnnamed: Added player to the Standings tab.
ui.replay.resultHint: Filled in from the replay; change anything. Tournament name and format come from the Standings tab.
ui.teamBattle.setsIntro: Paste one replay per set, one per line, in set order. Use the last game of each set (Game 2 or 3): it has the final set score. Players on the left go to your team; use ⇄ to swap if a replay lists them the other way round.
ui.teamBattle.pasteLinks: Paste Showdown replay links, one per line (the last game of each set).

ui.home.metaDescription: VGC tools from Mismatched: tournament graphics, DMV Invitational standings and more.
ui.home.tagline: VGC tools for players and organizers
ui.home.graphics.title: Graphics Generator
ui.home.graphics.description: The Ultimate VGC Graphics Generator. Many different templates from top cut to brackets, and you can auto fill standings and player teams from all kinds of things, including pictures of a monitor with standings, a .tdf file, a picture of a teamsheet, or even a screenshot of the team in Champions!
ui.home.graphics.previewAlt: Example graphic: a Top Cut in the Comic Book style, made with the sample tournament
ui.home.invitational.description: Points standings for the DMV Invitational, a major tournament at the end of the year for DMV players you qualify for based solely off your performance in DMV locals.

ui.home.calendar.title: Calendar
ui.home.calendar.description: View all upcoming locals from your state or a group of states, and sync them to your own calendar or add them to your Discord.
